meta.title: Audit & Stress Test Reports
meta.epic: 10 - Live Trading Production Readiness & Lighter.xyz Integration

story-context.story-summary: Generate reports from audit and stress test results for users and stakeholders to review production readiness of the system.

acceptance-criteria.criterion: Audit report from YAML findings: summary by severity, resolution status, regression test coverage
Stress test report from JSON results: scenario results, pass/fail, key metrics
Reports saved to docs/live-trading/ as markdown files
Report generation runnable as command or script

key-tasks.task: Implement audit report generation from YAML findings
Implement stress test report generation from JSON results
Test report generation with sample data

architecture-context.pattern: Reports generated from actual test data. Can be run manually or as part of CI. Human-readable markdown output.

technical-specifications.spec:
def load_findings(findings_dir: Path) -> list[dict]: findings = [] for yaml_file in findings_dir.glob("*.yaml"): with open(yaml_file) as f: data = yaml.safe_load(f) findings.extend(data.get("findings", [])) return findings
def generate_audit_report(findings: list[dict]) -> str: severity_counts = Counter(f["severity"] for f in findings) status_counts = Counter(f["status"] for f in findings) with_tests = sum(1 for f in findings if f.get("regression_test")) # Generate markdown report
